༄༅/ /nyer lnga nyi shu rtsa lnga'i sbyor ba rin chen srog gi rgyab rten zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// nyer lnga nyi shu rtsa lnga'i sbyor ba rin chen srog gi rgyab rten zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

nyer lnga nyi shu rtsa lnga'i sbyor ba rin chen srog gi rgyab rten zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya 'od kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// spyi bcos nor bu'i phreng ba las// kha 'thor man ngag gdams pa'i mchog /nyi shu lnga yi sbyor ba 'di// kun gyis shes pa ma yin yang*// sman pa mang po tshogs pa'i tshe// mkhas pa'i grags dkar thob pa dang*// nyam thag nad las grol ba dang*// sman mang gis sdug bcos med la/ /yan lag sbyor ba nyi shu lnga// sngon chad ma tshang 'thor ba dag /kho bos bshad do gces par zung*/ ༈ /dang po bdud rtsi nyer lnga ni/ */sman gyi rgyal po bzang po drug /shing gi rgyal po dri ldan gsum// srog chags rtsi yi rgyal po gnyis// chu yi rus pa gang gi rwa// 'bras bu gsum dang zi ra gnyis// spod rgyal gnyis dang chu sman gnyis// gser zangs ru rta nyi dga' rnams// shing bcud dag gi rtar bskyon te// gung gnyis chu grang bskol gyis phul// yang na sbrang gi rta la bskyon// rims dug tsha ba byer rnying dang*// dreg grum mdze dang rengs 'khums dang*// mkhal nad rtsa nad tsha grang dang*// gnyan tshad 'gram 'khrugs rtsar byer zhan// mdor na nad mang bcos rnying dang*// sman pas bcos sdug gyur pa la// sbyor ba 'di yis slebs pas chog /yid bzhin nor bu rin chen gter// dgos 'dod khyad par 'di las 'byung*// rgyun shes bu yi gser chos las// gcig tu dril nas gdams pa'o/ ༈ /gnyis pa dngul chu nyer lnga ni// 'bigs byed dul ma sa bcud dang*// bzang drug 'dre 'jigs mnyer ma can// shing kun sug smel gla rtsi dang*| |stag sha chu ser sman gsum dang*// gser bye mkhal ma zho sha dang*// 'bras gsum go yu ma nu dang*// rgya tshwa ru rta grogs shing dang*// rgya mtsho'i lbu rnams ril bu dril// sle tres pi ling thang gis phul// mdze gza' skran dang dmu chu dang*// dug dang gag lhog pags nad dang*// ya ma dkar nag dreg grum 'bam// mkhal nad chu ser nad rigs kun// myur du sel bar gdon mi za/

༈ /gsum pa dpa' bo nyer lnga ni// thar nu tri byid zab lag gsum// sbyong bar byed pa'i sman gsum yin// btsan dug stag sha re lcag gsum// gsod par byed pa'i sman gsum yin// sa bcud rgya tshwa sdig srin gsum// rtsa la rgyug pa'i sman gsum yin// 'dre 'jigs dri ldan 'dzin pa gsum// 'dul bar byed pa'i sman gsum yin// shu dag spu nag a byag gsum// mtha' nas sdud pa'i sman gsum yin// gur gum cu gang gi waṃ gsum// spyi ru dgos pa'i sman gsum yin// a ru hong len sha chen gsum// tshod 'dzin byed pa'i sman gsum yin// chu ser nad la sman gsum bsdeb// mkhal mar mkhal ma rigs gsum bsdeb// glo tshad tsan+dan ga pur bsdeb// rtsa la khrid na byang pa bsdeb// gzhan yang kha sgyur rig pas dpyad// kun la ka ra sbyar bar bya// kha sgyur med na nyer gcig la// kha sgyur gsum gsum ka rar bcas// nyi shu rtsa lnga'i sbyor ba 'dis| |lo brgyad chus sbrus bra ril tsam// dril la lnga bdun dgu bcu gnyis// nad stobs sbyar la btang ba yis// gag lhog gzer gsum ya ma'i rigs// chu ser dkar nag gzer thung rigs// bdun drug khrag tu 'khru ba dang*// skor le'i tsha ba la sogs kun// 'joms par byed pa'i dpa' bo yin/ ༈ /bzhi pa a ru nyer lnga ni// a ru gser mdog rdog ma gcig /cu gur li dang dzā sug ka /shing gnyis 'bras gsum bse ru dang*// gi waṃ pi ling ru rta dang*// shing kun tshos dang zi ra gnyis// 'bri ta gser bye shing tsha dang*// lcam pa sdig srin ka ra sbyar// gung gnyis btang bas rtsa dkar dang*// rtsa nad mkhal 'gram byer pa dang*// khrag nad mkhal mar bab sogs la// bdud rtsi bas kyang 'di nyid bsngags/ ༈ /lnga pa rtsa dkar nyer lnga ni// bzang drug tsan+dan a ga ru// bse ru gi waṃ gla rtsi pi pi ling*// ru rta nya khog shing tsha zi ra gnyis// 'bri ta sa 'dzin gser bye 'bras bu gsum// lcam pa sdig srin ka ra sbyar ba yis// rtsa dkar tsha ba'i nad rigs kun// me dbal chu yis bsad dang mtshungs/

༈ /drug pa bse ru nyer lnga ni// bse ru go dor bzang po drug /tsan+dan gnyis dang ge sar gnyis// rgya ru ru rta chu sman gsum// zi ra dkar po ba sha ka /ut+pal 'bras gsum li ga dur// gi waṃ ka ra sbyar ba yis// blo snag rgya mtsho tsam yang skem par byed/ ༈ /bdun pa bong khrag nyer lnga ni// bong khrag tsan+dan dkar dmar gi waṃ dang*// bzang drug chu ser sman gsum ge sar gnyis/ tig ta sle tres stab seng 'bras bu gsum// gla rtsi spang rgyan be do ba sha ka /ka ra sbyar ba'i nyi shu rtsa lnga 'di// gung gnyis seng ldeng khu bas phul la gtang*// se 'bru lnga dang nangs nub ltag pa sprad// dwangs ma gnas 'jog chu ser tsha ba skem/ ༈ /brgyad pa khyung chen nyer lnga ni// snying khrag sha rus rgyus pa'i steng*// zab lag bra bran ti dang ni// dan rog spang rtsi do bo dang*// sngon bu tri byid sdig srin dang*// sga skya shing kun dri chen dang*// dom mkhris gi waṃ tsan+dan gnyis// mtshal dkar sna ma'i 'bras bu dang*// ba sha ka dang sha chen dang*// 'dzin pa 'dre 'jigs sbyar ba yi| |byer sdud skrang 'bras lhog pa dang*// gnyan rigs ma lus 'joms par byed/ ༈ /dgu pa tsan+dan nyer lnga ni// tsan+da dkar dang bzang po drug /ru rta zi ra dkar po dang*// ba le ka dang ba sha ka// gi waṃ tig ta shing mngar dang*// bong dkar 'bras bu gsum dang ni// tsan+dan dmar dang ut+pal sngo// a ga ru dang pu shel rtse// ge sar gnyis pa ka ra sbyar// glo nad byang khog 'khrugs rnams sel/ ༈ /bcu pa tig ta nyer lnga ni// rgya tig bod tig sum cu tig /gser gyi me tog dug mo nyung*// rgun 'brum kyi lce bong nga dkar// dzā ti a ru ru rta dang*/ /shing mngar cu gang a krong dkar/ /ba sha brag zhun gur gum dang*/ /sle tres sug smel pi pi ling*// shug tsher ka ra sbyar ba yis// don lnga'i mkhris nad ma lus sel| ༈ /bcu gcig spang rgyan nyer lnga ni// spang rgyan dkar dang tsan+dan gnyis// a ru ba le sle tres dang*// kaṇ+ḍa ka ri 'bras bu gsum// tig ta hong len skra bzang dang*// ba sha ka dang rgun 'brum dang*// shing mngar sro lo kyi lce dang*// bong dkar stong zil khra rkang dang*// gang chung rtsi dmar rkang gcig dang*// brag spos dkar po yar 'dren rnams// gtso bo cha gsum cha re dang*// mkhris pa che na g.yu 'brug dang*// za ba g.ya' kyi zangs rtsi bsdeb// rlung la dzā ti ru rta bsdeb// bad kan star bu 'u su bsdeb// tsha ba 'gram 'khrugs rims dug dang*| |khrag nad gre ba 'gags la phan// gtar ka mi dgos khyad chos yin/

༈ /bcu gnyis a gar nyer lnga ni// a ga ru dang dzā ti snying zho sha// shing kun kha ru tshwa dang li shi dang*| |sug smel cu gang gur gum a ru ra// ka ko la dang gi waṃ gla rtsi dang*// ru rta pho ril shing tsha dang*// byi tang ge sar zi ra gnyis// sga skya se 'bru pi ling spos dkar dang*// bu ram sbyar ba'i nyi shu rtsa lnga 'dis// srog rtsar rlung zhugs nad kun 'joms par byed/ ༈ /bcu gsum dzā ti nyer lnga ni// dzā ti kha ru rgya tshwa dang*// rgyam tshwa tsha ba gsum dang sle tres dang*// big pan thal ba byi tsher bzang po drug /a ga ru dang shing kun go snyod dang*// zi ra dkar nag tsi tra ka sha chen// ru rta li shi gla rtsi shing tsha dang*// bu ram sbyar ba'i nyi shu rtsa lnga 'dis// srog rlung snying rlung ma lus 'joms par byed/ ༈ /bcu bzhi li shi nyer lnga ni// li shi a ga ru dang dzā ti dang*// shing kun sha chen dang ni snying zho sha| |a ru kha ru tshwa dang bse ru dang*// sga tig gla rtsi dpa' ser yung ba dang*// sga skya ru rta rdo rgyus spang spos dang*// bong dkar pi pi ling dang shu dag dang*// gu gul shing tsha cu gang bu ram sbyar// rlung nad nyi shu ma lus 'di yis sel/ ༈ /bco lnga gla rtsi nyer lnga ni// dri ldan 'dre 'jigs shing kun dang*// spu nag btsan dug shu dag dang*// ru rta thar nu brag zhun dang*| |mu zi ser nag ba bla dang*// ldong ros sgog skya tshwa dmar dang*// dkar nag tshur gnyis stag sha dang*// lcags phye tshwa dkar pi pi ling*// sbal pa sbrul dang nya sha dang*// lcum rtsa tri byid spyang ki'i lce// sbyar bas gnyan gzer gag lhog dang*// slebs pas chog pa'i sbyor ba yin/ ༈ /bcu drug stong zil nyer lnga ni// stong ri zil pa cha che la// zangs rtsi stag sha 'dre 'jigs dang*// spos dkar spang spos dri ldan dang*// gnyer ma rtsod tshigs ba bla dang*// ru rta sbal rgyab mtshal dkar dang*// ra dug re lcag cung zhi dang*// sro lo shing mngar rgun 'brum dang*// tsan+dan gnyis dang a ru ra// rgya skegs sman chen sbrang dang sbyar// gnyan 'bras gag lhog gzer nad 'joms/

༈ /bcu bdun skyer se nyer lnga ni// skyer pa 'om bu bar shun dang*// dpa' ser yung nga re ral dang*// tshwa sna tshogs tshad yungs kar dang*// bra ban+ti dang tshur dkar dang*// g.yer ma ser nag shu dag dang*// ma nu sug smel thang phrom dkar| |bong nga dkar dmar thang khrom nag /'u su gla rtsi bse ru dang*// a ru dkar po chig thub dang*// rgyal po shing bal sbyar la gtang*// sha dug la sogs dug rigs dang*// tsha grang nad kun sel bar byed// ban kan skya smug la gtong na// skya bo se 'bru bzhi pa la// sga skya bsnan pa sbyar la btang*// skya ser 'thab dus cong zhi drug pa bsnan// ser smug 'thab dus bse yab se 'bru dang*// ma nu 'u su star bu gser me tog so na puṣ+pa// dug mo nyung dang gser mdog bsnan// tsha shas che na tig ta ba sha ka /grang shas che na sga skya da lis bsdeb// khrag shas che na ru rta skyu ru bsdeb/ ༈ /bco brgyad gi waṃ nyer lnga ni// gi waṃ a ru gla rtsi dang*// bse ru bzang drug tsan+dan dkar dmar dang*// pi pi ling dang ru rta re skon dang*// shing tshwa zi ra gnyis dang 'bri ta dang*// gser gyi bye ma sdig srin 'bras bu gsum// sra 'bras sbyar bas bad kan skya smug sel// dug nad glo ba'i nad kyang sel bar byed/ ༈ /bcu dgu go dor nyer lnga ni// ga dor bse ru rgun 'brum dang*// gi waṃ ut+pal cu gang dang*// rgun 'brum ga pur tsan+dan gnyis// dom mkhris li sug ka ko la| |zi ra thal rdo so ma ra// ba sha ka dang ba le ka /shing mngar dzā ti ka ra sbyar// glo bar mtshon phog sos par gdon mi za/ ༈ /nyi shu thang chen nyer lnga ni// kha che gur gum thang gi gtso bo la// a bar skyur gsum ma nu pa tra dang*// ma nu spos dkar tig ta hong len dang*// kyi lce bong dkar 'u su par+pa ta// rgyal ba'i spyan can 'khri shing pa to la// ldum bu re ral phag khrag gang ga chung*// ut+pal ba sha ka dang pri yang ku// se 'bru sug smel so phag brag zhun rnams// sbyar ba'i thang chen nyi shu rtsa lnga 'dis// dug dang smug po tshad rnying byer ba sdud| |tsha grang cha snyoms dang kha 'gags pa 'byed// rlung mi skye la bad kan mkhris pa sel// de phyir thang sbyor kun gyi rgyal por bshad/

༈ /nyer gcig ut+pal nyer lnga ni// ut+pal gi waṃ gur gum dang*// bong dkar pad+ma ge sar dang*// na ga ge sar mdung rtse dang*// sbal rgyab mtshal dkar srad dkar dang*// spang rgyan spos dkar tsan+dan gnyis// li shi sug smel a ru ra// mu tig cong zhi 'u su dang*// tsi tra ka dang li ga dur// so phag ma nu ru rta sbyar// tshad rnying 'byed par byed pa'i mchog ༈ /nyer gnyis ga pu+ur nyer lnga ni// ga pur cu gang rgun 'brum dang*// ge sar gnyis dang tsan+dan gnyis// dzā ti ut+pal li ga dur// sle tres ma nu ba sha ka /'u su bse ru 'bu su haṃ// stag sha rgya ru kyi lce ba// star bu tsha la tsi tra ka /a ru lcags dreg spang spos sbyar// tshad ro rnying pa 'don par byed/ ༈ /nyer gsum ga pur nyer lnga ni// ga pu+ur bzang po drug dang a ga ru// tsan+dan dkar dmar ut+pal ge sar gnyis| |ru rta zi ra dkar po ba le ka /shing tshwa chu srin sder mo pu shel tse// spang spos rdo dreg dmar po 'bu su haṃ// tsha grang 'bras bu gsum dang tsha ba gsum// rig pa'i mdas bsnun tsha grang bab dang sbyar// 'gram 'khrugs nad rnying tsha ba rnying pa sel/ ༈ /nyer bzhi se 'bru nyer lnga ni// se 'bru bzang po drug dang tsha ba gsum// rgya tshwa ze tshwa rgyam tshwa 'gron thal dang*// ka ped shing tshwa ma nu na le sham// kha ru tshwa dang 'bras gsum tig ta dang*// hong len ru rta dang sbyar ka ra'i rta// phye ma chu grang gis phul btang ba yis// ma zhu ba dang pho ba'i me drod nyams// dwangs ma 'grib sogs pho nad gcong dang ni// grang ba'i nad kun 'joms pa'i me dpung yin/ ༈ /nyer lnga mdung rtse nyer lnga ni// mdung rtse dkar po bse ru bzang drug dang*// rgya ru go dor dang ni kha sha'i rwa// ti tsha sbal rgyab gangs thigs go snyod dang*// tsan+dan gnyis dang seng ldeng dbang po lag /gi waṃ dom mkhris gla rtsi 'bras bu gsum| |ka ra'am sbrang ngam bu ram ril bu dril// tho rangs zos pas mig nad ma lus sel// de ltar sbyor ba nyi shu rtsa lnga yi// sde tshan zab la don che tshegs chung 'di// sngon chad so sor 'thor ba lta bu zhig

/'dug tshe 'bad pas phyogs gcig bsgrigs pa 'di// sngon byon mkhas mang gzhung lugs mang po la// legs par sbyangs pa'i dge slong rig pa'i gnas// che chung bcu smra shes ldan shes rlom can// sman pa chos kyi grags pas bris pa dge// lcags sprel chu stod zla ba yi// yar gyi tshes brgyad dge ba'i dus// mdo khams stod phyogs zla dgon du| |sbyar ba re zhig rdzogs par grub// //maṅga laṃ//
